# TelegramGeeks Pro — AI Search & Indexing Context (llms.txt)

> TelegramGeeks Pro is a next-generation Telegram automation operating system, AI persona conversational warming platform, and MTProto marketing suite.

## Core Platform Summary
- **Architecture**: Dual-layer architecture consisting of a standalone Windows Desktop client (Electron + embedded FastAPI) and a modern Web Cloud App (Next.js 15 + FastAPI).
- **Module Count**: 77+ high-concurrency MTProto modules covering account registration, 2-way TData conversion, scrapers, mass messaging, and group management.
- **AI Personas**: Autonomous AI personas powered by dual Soul Prompts, 3-tier episodic/semantic memory, dynamic emotional state machines, and context-aware natural conversation.
- **Anti-Ban Defense**: Predictive flood guards, peer-flood delay algorithms, device fingerprint cloaking, and automatic mobile 4G/5G proxy rotation.

## Key Feature Categories
1. **Account Operations**: Two-way TData <-> Telethon Session+JSON converter, 30-day progressive booster/warmer, SMS registrar (25+ providers), SpamBot restriction remover.
2. **Audience & Parsing**: Member scraper from public/private chats, active-only filter, global chat search, hidden member analyzer, comment parser.
3. **Messaging & Outreach**: Mass direct messaging (DM), group inviter with admin bypass, channel auto-forwarder, interactive poll voter, reaction booster.
4. **AI Personas & Neuro-Text**: Autonomous multi-account conversational warm-up, neuro-text spin generator, multi-lingual contextual responder.
5. **Infrastructure & Security**: Hardware DPAPI encrypted credential vault, standalone local SQLite database, MTProto session duplicator, proxy speed benchmark.

## Commercial Licensing & Plans
- **Starter Tier ($49/mo)**: Full scraper tools, 2-way TData converters, basic warming.
- **Pro Tier ($149/mo)**: All 77 modules, autonomous AI personas, mass DM & inviter engines, unlimited proxies.
- **Enterprise ($499/mo)**: Source code access, dedicated API cluster, custom MTProto protocols, priority support.
